verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted HTTP API, so offering a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question, but the probe found no spec: every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The documented headers, the interactive code builder and the `x-json-schema` extraction feature are not a machine-readable spec of the API itself, and nothing else in the pack shows one.
